# Uchit Vyas

> Lead forward deployed engineer in Melbourne, Australia, focused on AI-led enterprise transformation. Fifteen years taking payment, lending, data and core platforms from plan to production, mostly inside regulated banks in Asia and Australia, and now AI agents and AI services for large enterprises. Author of five books with Apress and Packt (2013 to 2016). US patent US11334348B2. Employed full-time; not available for consulting.
